title: NOT A 5QUART COLANDER
text:
NOT A 5QUART COLANDER. This is NOT a 5-quart colander, more like a 3.5 size. So, if you are looking for a 5-quart colander read other reviews stating this is smaller than 5 quarts.

Also, the feet are small and do not allow room for the liquid to drain well, and this colander cannot be hung up since there are no holes in which to do so and no handles. I'm very disappointed since I need a larger-sized colander and this one is way too small.

So, if you want a colander you can hang up, this colander is not for you. Again, this is a 3.5 sized colander at best and is NOT a 5 quart-sized colander. Fair warning.

features: Soft, non-slip handles for a firm, comfortable grip
Perforated design for fast and thorough straining
Nests in Mixing Bowls for easy straining and storage

description: The Oxo good grips 3-quart stainless steel colander's perforated design allows for fast and thorough straining of orzo, angel hair pasta, fruit, vegetable and more. Soft, nonslip, elevated handles allow for a firm, comfortable grip. The colander can be used with any bow but is sized to nest perfectly in Oxo stainless steel mixing bowls for convenient straining and storage. Five feet provide stability in the sink or on the countertop.
